form.official-title: To abolish the Office of Financial Research.

section.header: Abolition of the Office of Financial Research

subsection.text: Subtitle B of the Financial Stability Act of 2010 (12 U.S.C. 5341 et seq.) is repealed.

paragraph.text: The table of contents in section 1(b) of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is amended by striking the items relating to subtitle B of title I.
The Financial Stability Act of 2010 (12 U.S.C. 5301 et seq.) is amended—

in paragraph (4), by striking paragraph (6) and inserting paragraph (5); and

subclause.text: by redesignating subparagraphs (B) through (E) as subparagraphs (A) through (D), respectively; and
